note: Set B is preferred because it contains significantly fewer incorrect claims (3 vs 10), adhering to the preference for precision over recall. While Set A captures more correct equipment data, its high rate of misbound attributes in the finish schedule (e.g., assigning paint colors to tiles) reduces trustworthiness. Set B shares the same specific misbinding errors but limits the total noise.
remarks: Both sets suffer from row-alignment errors in the Finish and Furniture schedules (e.g. claiming Porcelain Tile has Laminate dimensions). Set A's broader coverage of Equipment and Plumbing is valuable but outweighed by the volume of hallucinated/misbound finish data.
